task: Fence + fence-gate buildable (1 wood, passable, low) — vanilla Structure-tab staple
wiki_acceptance: B3 (binary) — a fence is buildable from Architect, renders a LOW barrier, and BLOCKS NOTHING (a pawn paths straight through where a fence stands; gate variant likewise passable). SATISFIED.
files_owned_and_changed: skills/game-prototype/unity-project/Assets/Scripts/BuildManager.cs (EDIT — the single build-catalogue lane this wave)

implementation.enum: Added BuildManager.Mode.Fence + Mode.FenceGate (one entity, gate via IsGate flag).
implementation.cost: fenceCost = 1 (목재/wood); FenceGate uses the same cost (a fence opening, not a costlier door).
implementation.lazy_path: Mirrors the Lamp/FloorStone/TableChair lazy-procedural prefab+sprite path EXACTLY: EnsureFenceSprite/EnsureFenceGateSprite -> LoadOrBuildFenceSprite (AssetDatabase #if UNITY_EDITOR, else procedural) -> BuildProceduralFenceSprite mirrors _gen_fence.py pixel-for-pixel. EnsureFencePrefab/EnsureFenceGatePrefab -> BuildFenceTemplate (in-memory HideAndDontSave template). Never null/magenta even with no asset import.
implementation.passable: FenceEntity carries NO collider (like FloorEntity). PawnMovement.IsBlockedAt reads ONLY terrain tilemap (Water/Rock) so a built fence is invisible to terrain blocking; with no collider it is invisible to physics/wall occupancy too. CellOccupied does NOT list FenceEntity -> a fence neither blocks other placements nor is blocked. Net: pawn walks straight through.
implementation.low_barrier: Prefab SpriteRenderer sortingOrder = 2 (above floors @1, below furniture/walls @5+). Sprite drawn in the LOWER HALF of the 16x16 tile (wood at y>=7) so it reads waist-height, never a wall.
implementation.no_cover_math: Deliberately NONE — cover is OP-gated/over-scope per lane. FenceEntity carries no cover logic.
implementation.hotkey: E for Fence (free; avoids B/F/G/T/Y/N/R/X/M/P/K/J/H/L and WASD camera keys A/D/S/W). Fence-GATE surfaced via Architect menu ONLY (no hotkey) to stay off contended key space.
implementation.architect: Both fence + fence-gate added to the EXISTING 'Structure (구조)' category alongside Wall/WallStone/Door. Routes through the existing RefreshContent onClick -> BuildManager.SetMode plumbing with ZERO click-plumbing change.
